newsitem.title: EU: EP WOMEN'S RIGHTS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 22-23.
newsitem.headline: EP WOMEN'S RIGHTS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 22-23.

text.p: Committee on Women's Rights [[ Wednesday 22 January 1997 ]] PUBLIC MEETING ===] Wedmesday, 22 January 1997, 3 p.m. 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 220.301 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 29/30 October 1996 (PE 220.292 ) - 11 November 1996 (PE 219.540 ) - 25/26 November 1996 (PE 220.293 ) - 17/18 December 1996 (PE 220.297 ) 3. Chairperson's announcements 4. Reports by Committee Members on the activities of other Committees of which they are Members ===] In the presence of the Commission ===] 3.30 p.m. 5. Exchange of views with Mr Adrianus P.W. MELKERT, President-in-Office for Social Affairs and Employment, on aspects of Dutch Presidency falling within the competence of this Committee ===] 5 p.m. 6. Current situation concerning the implementation of the NOW programme - Exchange of views with Mr. QUIGLEY, DG V, Head of Unit, European Commission 7. Integrating gender issues in development cooperation (T04199) COS0306 COM(95)0423 C4-0410/95 + FEMM Avis GRONER Lissy. (PSE) (PE219.537 ) F DEVE Fond R JUNKER Karin. (PSE) - Consideration of draft opinion ===] 6 p.m. 8.
